title: Preparation reaches ready state
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean words $w,s$, there is a time $t\le 2(|s|+1)$ such that, from the specified initial configuration on input $w$ with $s$ on the first work tape and all other work tapes empty, the preparation machine is never in state $(2,\,[|w|<|s|])$ at any time $j<t$, and at time $t$ it is in the specified ready configuration with that state, input-head position $1+\min(|s|,|w|)$, and all work-tape heads at zero.
